summary: A second-order linear oscillator with damping ratio ζ and natural angular frequency ω. The system returns to equilibrium with oscillation magnitude controlled by ζ.

ranges.phrase: Effectively undamped — the oscillation decays slowly; a small disturbance rings for many cycles.
Underdamped — the system oscillates several times before settling.
Moderately damped — visible overshoot before convergence.
Near critical damping — the fastest non-oscillatory return to equilibrium.
Overdamped — no oscillation; smooth exponential decay back to equilibrium.
Slow oscillation: natural period of roughly {omega_period} time units.
Moderate oscillation: natural period ≈ {omega_period} time units.
Fast oscillation: natural period under {omega_period} time units — many cycles per observed window.
